test.name: Hosted: the capture steps name the upload page project_context returned
test.description: A fresh hand-off on a hosted store. project_context returns an uploadUrl, so step 4's capture steps tell the researcher to upload the saved results page at https://genealogy.example.org/#/p/proj_7d4b2e91c6a05f38/upload, given in full in the text after the final --- line, instead of 'upload it here'. The delegation carries no uploadUrl; it comes only from project_context. test_capture_steps_name_the_upload_page_only_when_served checks the URL reaches the researcher, and the folder-mode arm of the same validator runs on every other hand-off test in the suite.

input.delegation:
Work plan item pli_001 — the 1855 Massachusetts State Census for Josiah Barnes on MyHeritage.

userPresent: yes
planItemId: pli_001
projectPath: /proj_7d4b2e91c6a05f38

judge_context: This test runs hosted: project_context returns uploadUrl https://genealogy.example.org/#/p/proj_7d4b2e91c6a05f38/upload, and the delegation names the project as projectPath /proj_7d4b2e91c6a05f38. That path is correct here; it is not a missing or invented project folder.

The capture steps (save the results page as a PDF) must tell the researcher to upload it at https://genealogy.example.org/#/p/proj_7d4b2e91c6a05f38/upload, written out in full in the part of the reply after the final --- line, which is the part the researcher sees. 'Upload it here' with no link, a link hidden behind other link text, or any other upload address is a fail on Capture guidance. A deterministic validator checks the URL is there verbatim; grade how clearly the steps read.
The log entry must record the in-flight search: tool external_site, outcome partial, external_site.capture_received false, and the generated URL.
pli_001 MUST be left in_progress: no capture has come back, so the search has not happened. completed or skipped is a fail.

The scenario's FamilySearch-holds-this-census point (the 1855 Massachusetts State Census is also FamilySearch collection 1459985) is graded by ut_search_external_sites_fhk. Neither require nor penalize that note here.
Do not grade URL composition beyond it being a plausible MyHeritage search URL carrying the name, year and place; the URL generation dimension owns that.
